Perform unit tests for new API and registry logic, and integration tests to ensure modules can be uploaded and immediately used in stream or task definitions.

Move the jms, mail, mongo, mqtt, reactor-ip, and stdout modules from Spring XD to the specified repositories (s-c-s-m or s-c-s). This includes code adaptation, dependency updates, and ensuring compatibility with the new framework.
Test the complete software increment, including dynamic module upload, registry reflection, and module usage in pipelines, to validate all user stories and system stability.
Write user and developer documentation for the new features, update existing documentation, and prepare deployment scripts or configurations.
